scope: 13 previously used dev documents; two fields only; not the public-v8 four-field image benchmark.

findings.issue: Required-documents changed from empty to the registration-method sentence; exact source copying still misclassified the field.
Required-documents changed from empty to a block about elevator repair, with no actual document requirement.
Candidate selected eligibility text as documents and still omitted the application form; exact matching did not establish category correctness.
Raw candidate selected dispatch metadata/enclosures as required documents and altered characters; source validator hid it.

conclusions: Removing redundant evidence generation alone did not solve the failures.
Postprocessing can conceal malformed outputs, so passing span checks cannot be attributed solely to the model.
Reviewed training data should include empty-field negatives, category boundaries, conditions and faithful spans under realistic OCR noise.
This experiment does not prove fine-tuning will improve quality; no model weights updated.
